verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents a check-deposit service that mails received checks directly to the customer's bank of deposit for $20 per check, with complimentary overnight shipping for Bank of America, Chase and Wells Fargo accounts. That covers getting checks to the bank without the founder handling the paper. The evidence does not show the provider endorsing checks, depositing them itself (they are shipped to the bank instead), or reconciling deposits. Missing for 10: provider-side endorsement, direct or electronic deposit (rather than shipping to the bank), deposit reconciliation or confirmation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, checks that arrive in the mail get deposited to my bank account by the provider — endorsed, deposited, and reconciled without the paper touching my hands

citations.quote: Deposit checks into your bank account by having the checks mailed directly to your bank of deposit. A reliable, easier way to manage payments remotely.
Checks forwarded directly to your bank so you can get paid faster (additional fees apply)
$20 per check; complimentary overnight shipping is provided for checks deposited into accounts with Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, and Wells Fargo.
